name: Talisman of Dawn
source:
In the dryland of adulthood, Sherazade likes to spend her days cultivating small stories she keeps only to herself and her younger sister, Duna. Tales about everything and anything -- lullabies for the heart. When Duna decides that she wants to go to Persepolis to chase her ambitious dreams of becoming a painter, the weight of being a responsible adult fall onto Sherazade's shoulders.

Forced to marry Sultan Shariar, she decides to use her storytelling skills to avoid sleeping with a man she doesn't even know. But what Sher doesn't imagine, is that Shariar is just as helpless as her, following advice that doesn't make sense to him, trying to paint himself with the colors of society's expectations.

Each night, they'll recognize the other behind layers of self-sacrifice and fears of ostracism, finding their true selves that they so eagerly tried to hide. A story about a man who didn't understand himself, and a woman who could translate the world into stories...

[From [url=https://lenlen403.itch.io/talisman-of-dawn-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在成年后的干旱地区，谢拉扎德喜欢花时间写一些小故事，这些故事只留给自己和妹妹杜娜。关于一切的故事——心灵的摇篮曲。当杜娜决定去波斯波利斯追逐成为一名画家的雄心勃勃的梦想时，谢拉扎德肩上担负着做一个负责任的成年人的重担。

被迫嫁给苏丹沙里亚尔后，她决定利用自己讲故事的技巧来避免和一个她根本不认识的男人上床。但谢尔没有想到的是，沙里亚尔和她一样无助，听从对他来说毫无意义的建议，试图给自己涂上社会期望的色彩。

每天晚上，他们都会在层层自我牺牲和对排斥的恐惧背后认出对方，找到他们急切想要隐藏的真实自我。一个不了解自己的男人和一个能把世界变成故事的女人的故事……
